out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Observed a one gallon bottle of cleaning chemical stored on the same shelf with clean equipment next to the three compartment sink. Also observed a bucket of wiping cloth solution (chemicals) stored over a container oc sauce next to the two compartment sink
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. The person in charge move the cleaning chemical during the inspection to correct. The person in charge relocated the OC sauce or the the wiping cloth solution bucket so that it was not stored over food.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: one door refrigerator had no thermometer in it.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. The person in charge installed a thermometer in the one door refrigerator during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Observed several fruit or drain flies in the rear prep area. Also observed several ants on the shelving where the soda syrup is stored/dispensed.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. The person in charge contacted pest control during the visit.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the three compartment sink and wiping cloth buckets with a concentration of 150 ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. The automatic dispenser was not properly dispensing the product. The manager corrected this by manually adjusting the sanitizer concentration by adding product to the three compartment sink sanitizer basin and each of the wiping cloth containers. CDI.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: garlic and ginger in oil on the cook line was 63º F and being held at room temperature.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Garlic in oil is considered a TCS food and must be held either hot or cold, and not at room temperature. The manager stated the container is emptied frequently, at least every two hours. The ESH explained that time as a public health control could be used if requested. The manager discarded the product to correct. CDI.
